settings.question: What do BS 5852 Crib 5 and Crib 7 mean?
settings.answer: BS 5852 is the British Standard method for assessing the ignitability of upholstered seating. Crib 5 and Crib 7 are two of its wooden-crib ignition sources; Crib 7 is the larger and more demanding of the two.

settings.question: Which fabric meets Crib 7?
settings.answer: CHANCE Crib 7 | B1. It is also certified to DIN 4102 B1 and NF P 92-507 M1, and is designed for high-traffic venues such as stadiums and auditoriums.

settings.question: Do these fabrics carry other fire certifications?
settings.answer: Yes. Each collection lists its full set of fire certifications on its product page — for example EN 1021-1+2 and IMO 2010 FTP Code Part 8 on several collections. Ask our team for the test reports your project requires.

settings.question: Does the fabric certificate cover the finished chair?
settings.answer: A fire test covers the fabric as tested with the composite described in its report. Confirm the full upholstery build — foam, interliner and fabric — for your own project.

settings.question: Can I order samples?
settings.answer: Yes — samples are free. Add them to your cart from any collection, or contact us for project specifications.
